capability: A falsified reading that its controller follows is caught, its broken link and lying instrument named, and its true value reconstructed from drivers that cannot learn the lie back (ADR 0123).
competing_explanations: The relation is right but the attack is too small at these subtleties to see on any detector.
The hourly detrend absorbs a lie held steady at a fixed deficit, whatever detector feeds it.
The calibrator, not the detector, is the bottleneck once a crossing exists.

hypotheses.statement: The frozen loop's lags of at most a minute, and its level-form regression from every signal, learn the lie back from the controller; a directed, lagged map with declared roles and loops does not.
hypotheses.change: atlas-plant-map-v1 with ADR 0123's settings, then at most five more configurations overriding only its caps (max_drivers, max_lags_per_driver), stopping rule (min_gain) and horizons (horizon_seconds, form_horizon_seconds).

expected_benefit: More liar passes than the champion's 24 of 90 on ARENA_LIAR_SEEDS, water above 0 of 30, with no champion pass lost.
expected_regressions: The map's score may raise extra events on HAI 20.07 and spend budget the frozen detector spent on attacks; its larger divisor may push weak attacks under the threshold.
regression_slices: liar: every (plant, seed, subtlety) the champion passes on ARENA_LIAR_SEEDS
hai-20.07: recall within budget at least the champion's 37/38
evaluation_plan: ADR 0127. Each attempt is scored by scripts/arena.py on ARENA_LIAR_SEEDS and HAI 20.07. Attempt 1 is ADR 0123's settings unchanged. A configuration qualifies when it passes at least 24 of 90 with water above 0 of 30 (ADR 0123 §9.2), regressions(champion, candidate) is empty, and HAI 20.07 is at least 37/38 (§9.4). Among qualifying configurations the one chosen has the most passes, then the most water passes, then the fewest overrides. scripts/plant_map_dev.py measures §9.1, §9.5, §9.6, §9.7 and §9.9 for the configurations scored. The chosen configuration is then scored once on RED_TEAM_SEEDS (§9.3) after Elijah has read the §9 report. If none qualifies, that is the result.
